description_en: Queries the number of monthly active users for each month within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内各月的月活跃用户数
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-mau-report-data --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-date '2026-09-01 00:00:00' --end-date '2026-09-02 00:00:00' --product-type CloudApp --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMauReportData

parameters.help_en: The app instance group ID, which is used to filter data for a specified app instance group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID. If this parameter is not specified, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 200. If the specified value is greater than 1,500, it is processed as 1,500
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；大于 1500 时按 1500 处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. We recommend that you explicitly specify a value starting from `1`. If this parameter is not specified, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may return `0`
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The business region ID, which is used to filter report data. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选报表数据。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistical period. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The statistical interval includes the start and end boundaries. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。统计区间包含开始和结束边界。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistical period. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The value cannot be earlier than `StartDate`. The statistical interval includes the start and end boundaries. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，且不能早于 `StartDate`。统计区间包含开始和结束边界。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Required.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: Wuying Cloud App.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud Browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Edition workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Team Edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Dedicated Edition Linggou container workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud Phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。必填。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of `200` indicates that the request is processed successfully. Other values indicate that the request fails to be processed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

Count.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 满足查询条件的记录总数

MauReportDataModel.description_en: The list of monthly active user report data
MauReportDataModel.description_zh: 月活跃用户报表数据列表

Mau.description_en: The number of monthly active users in the statistical month. Unit: users
Mau.description_zh: 该统计月份内的月活跃用户数。单位：人

RegionId.description_en: The business region ID to which the report data belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 报表数据所属的业务地域 ID

StatDate.description_en: The statistical cutoff date used for the month. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd`. For the last month, this is usually the day before the requested `EndDate`. The date is interpreted as a calendar date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
StatDate.description_zh: 该月份采用的统计截止日期，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd`。最后一个月通常为请求 `EndDate` 的前一天。按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释

StatMonth.description_en: The statistical month. Format: `yyyy-MM`. The month is interpreted as a calendar month in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
StatMonth.description_zh: 统计月份，格式：`yyyy-MM`。按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然月解释

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. If the request is successful, `success` is usually returned
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
